caption: The video captures an open ocean under a pale clear sky, with lines of breaking waves and white foam. In the first view, two people in dark wetsuits are in the shore break. One crouches in the churning whitewater while another, nearer the camera, stands in the shallow wash holding a white surfboard painted with teal and red panels. A second, wider view shows a line-up of several surfers. In the mid-distance, a person in a dark wetsuit lies prone on a board before pushing up and rising to stand. Other surfers sit or float behind the breaking foam, one holding a white board at the left, others bobbing mid-frame and at the right. The standing surfer rides the breaking wave toward the camera, growing larger in frame while shifting from the left toward the center, arms outstretched for balance. The foam lines advance shoreward, while the foreground surfers drift only slightly with the wash as the clip runs.
relations: The foreground surfer holding the teal-and-red board drifts slightly with the shallow wash while maintaining an upright stance.
The surfer in the churning whitewater behind rises from a crouch to stand as the foam recedes.
A wider view shows a prone surfer pushing up to stand, then riding a breaking wave toward the camera.
The riding surfer shifts from left to center, extending arms for balance as the foam lines advance shoreward.
